title: kaxxa weeqih xaagi
intro: Tama num bool karmoomih addat qanxaffe le qamiidah soolak sugeeh, qanxaffe kee qanxaffe luk sugeh yan numma diifu fan seeco abak suge. Kaxxaam gibdih tan taqabitte kee farmo horah addat tan qilsa takkay immay, ta taama abeynit ellecabo amri elle yewqeh yan innal sinni farmol diggalsimeh suge.
clues: Anu sagla bool kee kontom liggiditte yi ummattah seecak, laqo kee bar, uqrat kee ummattah addal, qadli gita fan seecak tatruse.
Anu inni ummatta biyak le digaalak takkaawiseh, takkay immay oson sinni aytit feeraari heenih, sinni sartanat sinni buulen.
Anu tukteena xisam amriseh suge yi Rabbih intiitat, lee ane wayta way.
Anu taamitak suge wak, yi ummattah mirocti taturteeh, yoo anqasak sugte, takkay immay anu keenih warseh, xayi waktit nanu ken anqasak sugne.
Anu inni cado kee qabala yoo akah tangalennah xaaqimeh suge, takkay immay oson qaleel dacayri dooreenih, toh ken cateleemih yaamineenih.
Yi merrayti ellecaboh ardi lee yanxuqeek lakal kee qaran rob radak sugeek lakal Judi qalel rabboh temeete.
arabic: وَقِيلَ يَـٰٓأَرْضُ ٱبْلَعِى مَآءَكِ وَيَـٰسَمَآءُ أَقْلِعِى وَغِيضَ ٱلْمَآءُ وَقُضِىَ ٱلْأَمْرُ وَٱسْتَوَتْ عَلَى ٱلْجُودِىِّ ۖ وَقِيلَ بُعْدًۭا لِّلْقَوْمِ ٱلظَّـٰلِمِينَ
verse: And it was said, "O earth, swallow your water, and O sky, withhold [your rain]." And the water subsided, and the matter was accomplished, and it [i.e., the ship] came to rest on the [mountain of] Jūdiyy. And it was said, "Away with the wrongdoing people." (11:44)
